203: 		newResp, err := e.processLoginResponse(body, func(tokens sessionTokens) (string, string, error) {

205: 			snowflakeSession, err := e.AuthClient.CreateSnowflakeSession(ctx, types.CreateSnowflakeSessionRequest{

211: 				// renew the token even if it's not in our "tokens" cache.
212: 				TokenTTL: tokens.session.ttl + 600, // add 10 minutes
213: 			})
